notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
--script vuln runs all vulnerability-checking NSE scripts against discovered services. Cross-references versions against CVE databases and tests for common vulnerability patterns. Direct bridge from enumeration to exploitation planning.

=== OUTPUT VALUE ===
Against web server: identifies WordPress version, admin paths, valid usernames (http-wordpress-users), CVEs with CVSS scores and references. Against SMB: ms17-010 (EternalBlue) check. Against SSL: heartbleed, poodle checks.

=== DETECTION ===
vuln scripts send many probe requests and interact heavily with services — detectable by IDS. Run after confirming IPS won't block the source IP, or from a sacrificial scanning host.

=== COMBINATION ===
nmap -sV --script vuln -p <open_ports> <target>: fastest path from open port to vulnerability assessment.
